description: This file defines the GridItemDecoration class, which extends SectionItemDecoration, and is responsible for managing item offsets and spacing in a RecyclerView grid layout, specifically for a Nextcloud Notes Android client project.

classes.name: GridItemDecoration
classes.description: A class that manages item decoration offsets for a RecyclerView grid layout, handling spacing and span settings based on item type and position.

methods.name: GridItemDecoration
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoration with adapter, span count, section insets, and gutter size.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides method to set spacing offsets for each item in the RecyclerView based on its position and type.
